text:
jen_support: Customer reports sudden latency spikes and higher billing — they say traffic is routing to EU even though their client sets region=us-east
customer_ops: they provided a few request IDs and a curl sample, attaching here
jen_support: repro curl they sent:
```
curl -i https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'X-Client-Region: ' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
sam_runtime: ah, header is present but empty. our router treats empty header as "unset"? I thought we only fallback when header missing
akshay_oncall: router log for one of the request IDs (rid=cl_2026_0001):
```
INGRESS: received request rid=cl_2026_0001 headers={host:api.redwood.example, x-client-region:""} routed_to=edge-eu-2 reason=fallback.default_region
```
jen_support: customer says their SDK sometimes serializes region as an empty string when not configured — they didn't intend to send EU. Billing hit: they were charged cross-region egress for 120k tokens
customer_ops: customer is pretty upset, asked for root cause and mitigation ASAP :frowning:
sam_runtime: two angles — (1) SDKs sending empty header vs omitting header, (2) router semantics when header present but empty. current behavior: we prefer header if present; empty string maps to "empty" and we treat as value -> validation fails -> fallback to default_region (eu).
akshay_oncall: quick mitigation: we can change ingress to treat empty/whitespace-only region header as absent for the next deploy, low-risk config. I'll scope a hotfix.
jen_support: can we get a short-term workaround to give customer?
sam_runtime: ask them to upgrade SDK patch I just pinned (link in convo) or set env var REDWOOD_REGION=us-east. If they can't upgrade, instruct them to strip the header: `--header 'X-Client-Region:'` -> that's what caused it, they should omit the header entirely.
customer_ops: they tried `--header 'X-Client-Region:'` because curl example from their internal tools did that.
sam_runtime: adding a router log snippet showing header parsing edgecase:
```
parseRegionHeader(h) {
  if (h == null) return null;
  return normalize(h); // but normalize("") => "" and we don't treat as null 
}
```
akshay_oncall: action items: 1) hotfix ingress to treat empty/whitespace region header as absent (oncall) 2) runtime team to change normalization to reject empty and fallback to query param or default behavior (sam) 3) support to notify customer and apply credits for cross-region egress for incident window (jen)
jen_support: can you estimate ETA on the hotfix?
akshay_oncall: I can roll config change to staging in 20m, prod in ~2h if no regressions. Will open INC ticket INC-2026-472 and link here.
sam_runtime: for the longer term I'll add unit tests and a small change: treat header trimmed length == 0 as absent. Also add a router metric for "received-empty-region-header" so we can monitor SDKs that keep sending this.
jen_support: customer asked for repro steps we can send to their devs. here's suggested note: 
"If you are building an HTTP client, do not send an empty X-Client-Region header. Omit the header when region is not set. Example (curl): `curl -i https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`"
customer_ops: customer accepted temporary credit and will test SDK upgrade. They're requesting a postmortem once fixed.
akshay_oncall: linking router logs and opened INC-2026-472. assign to sam_runtime for runtime change.
sam_runtime: noted, I'll file a small PR and request fast-track review. Also will add metrics and a dashboard alert.
jen_support: thanks — I'll keep customer updated. tagging @customer_ops for billing follow-up. :thumbsup:
ingress-bot: New INC created: INC-2026-472 - treat empty X-Client-Region as absent (opened by akshay_oncall)
akshay_oncall: moving to close loop — will post after prod rollout.
jen_support: closing with customer in 48h after verification.
